The table has What, Weeks, Pages, Sheets and Printed columns for the front pages, Nov and Dec 2026, each month of 2027 and the spare week, plus a total. The two start boxes, 'Your first print, any date' and 'After that', replace the old before-2027 and later-2027 boxes, as the build_changes say.

visual.issue: Photo 3's alt text says the March calendar has 'week numbers 10 to 14'. After the ISO change, the grid shows weeks 9 to 13, so the listing states a fact the product contradicts (r003, r005).

Photos 3, 7 and 9 show pages as cropped fragments on white cards with drop shadows, with no punch holes. Photos 1, 2 and 6 show punched printed sheets, so the set is inconsistent. Photo 7's week crop also runs off the bottom of the frame.
Photo 5's point says 'Six usual print problems, solved', but the sheet lists five problems plus a 'Still stuck?' line.
Photo 1 shrinks the whole spread, so the day labels and kickers are tiny at Etsy zoom (r013). Photo 2 covers the detail.

The manual duplex steps say which side and edge to reload but not whether to reverse the page order of the stack. A one-sheet check-sheet test cannot reveal an order error, so a multi-sheet month row can come out mismatched.
